facts.fact: Tech Africa News says Nigeria introduced the National Digital Alphanumeric Postcode System on 1 October 2026, led by NIPOST with Milsat Technologies, and that it assigns an 11-character code to every addressable building.

Tech Africa News says NDAPS assigns a code to every addressable building in the country and its database holds structures across the entire country, mapped from satellite imagery and field verification.

systems.platform: Milsat Technologies satellite basemaps and GIS; public lookups resolve to AWS

facts.fact: Tech Africa News says the NITDA Sovereign Data Guidelines mandate that data generated, owned or controlled by the Nigerian government be hosted domestically, with foreign hosting only by explicit regulatory approval.

Tech Africa News says NITDA Cloud and CBN directives, effective January 2027, enforce in-country hosting for sensitive government data and require all payment transaction data generated in Nigeria to stay on domestic servers.
facts.system: NITDA Cloud guidelines and CBN directives

facts.fact: Tech Africa News describes the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 as restricting cross-border data transfers unless the recipient jurisdiction meets statutory adequacy standards or a legal exemption applies.
